note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two divisions, Maze and Drumbo, were contested; thirteen members were returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Carryduff, its retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Dromore Leader, 11 June 1949, p. 4; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). The council declared the Carryduff seat vacant on 10 January 1950 (Dromore Leader, 13 January 1950, p. 3), and in February 1950 chose James Carlisle to fill the vacancy (Banbridge Chronicle, 18 February 1950, p. 8): a casual vacancy filled by the council, not an election. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
